gtponder.ponder.input_bus_ui.title: Input Bus UI
gtponder.ponder.input_bus_ui.text_1: The panel is the machine's own UI, without the player inventory.
gtponder.ponder.input_bus_ui.text_2: 64 grass blocks go into slot 0; the panel shows the machine's real inventory.
gtponder.ponder.input_bus_ui.text_3: Covers can be put on a chosen side as well: a conveyor on top.
